summary: Repaired the payment-proof review boundary and its missing administrator read projection. Verified administrators with admin:payments.review can list active proofs with bounded status filtering and pagination, approve or reject pending proofs with strict reason/version input, replay terminal decisions idempotently, and receive only redacted metadata without private storage details or bank-verification claims.
